'''Relics''' are a unique class of items used for enchanting and special event mechanics.

== Acquisition ==
Relics can be obtained through:
* [[Excavations]] – Advanced dig sites.
* [[Traveling Merchant]] – Occasionally sells relics in his rotating stock, often in limited quantities.
* [[Treasure Chest|Treasure Chests]] - Some relics can be found in treasure chests from certain locations.
* From the [[Prospector's_Shop#Forever_Pack|Forever Pack (Robux)]]
* The [[Relic Crafting]] altar

== Usage ==
* Ingredients for enchanting.  
* Can be sold to a [[Merchant]] for {{$|10,000}}. 
* Activate unique in-game events.

|-|Luck Totem =
[[File:Luck_Totem.png|right|100px]]
Luck Totems can be placed in a dig site to grant all players in the effect radius a 2&times; {{stat|Luck}} boost. Each totem lasts 30 minutes, but multiple totems can be stacked to extend the time.

== Obtainment ==
* Purchase from the [[Shard Merchant]] in {{Fortune River}} or {{Caldera Park}} for {{Meteor Shards|300}}
* [[Treasure Chest]] rewards:
** {{Fortune River}}
** {{Fortune River Delta}}
** {{Sunset Beach}}
** {{Frostbite River}}
** {{Rotwood Swamp}}
** {{Starfall River}}
* [[Prospector's_Shop#Forever_Pack|Forever Pack (Robux)]]
* [[Prospector's_Shop#Totems|Prospector's Shop (Robux)]]
* [[Dredge Master]] random reward

== Usage ==
* Stand where you want to place the totem, select it from your backpack (or hotbar), and click '''once'''.
* To extend the time, stand in the effect radius of an already-placed totem (yours or someone else's), select the totem from your backpack/hotbar, and click once for each half-hour you want to add to the time.
* Totems cannot be moved once placed, so be careful when selecting one in your inventory, especially on mobile.

[[File:Strength_Totem.png|right|100px]]

* To extend the time, stand in the effect radius of an already-placed totem (yours or someone else's), select the totem from your backpack/hotbar, and click once for each half-hour you want to add to the time.
* Totems cannot be moved once placed, so be careful when selecting one in your inventory, especially on mobile.

|-|Luminant Totem =
Luminant Totems can be placed in a dig site to grant all players in the effect radius a boost of 1.5&times; {{stat|Capacity}}, +50% {{stat|Dig Speed}}, and +50% {{stat|Shake Speed}}. In addition, Luminant totems give immunity from the darkness in the {{Abyssal Depth}}, and keep the swamp monsters away in {{Rotwood Swamp}}. Each totem lasts 30 minutes, but multiple totems can be stacked to extend the time.

== Obtainment ==
* Purchase in {{Rotwood Swamp}} for {{Meteor Shards|600}}
* [[Treasure Chest]] rewards:
** {{Rotwood Swamp}}
** {{Starfall River}}
* Purchase in {{Haunted Creek}} shop for <span style="color:orange;">60</span> {{Candy}}
* [[Prospector's_Shop#Forever_Pack|Forever Pack (Robux)]]
* [[Dredge Master]] random reward

== Usage ==
* Stand where you want to place the totem, select it from your backpack (or hotbar), and click '''once'''.
* To extend the time, stand in the effect radius of an already-placed totem (yours or someone else's), select the totem from your backpack/hotbar, and click once for each half-hour you want to add to the time.
* Totems cannot be moved once placed, so be careful when selecting one in your inventory, especially on mobile.


|-|Friendship Totem =
Friendship Totems can be placed in a dig site to grant all players in the effect radius a {{stat|Luck}} boost. The amount of boost starts at 1.2&times; and increases by 0.2&times; for each additional player in the circle. If all 20 players on a server are in the totem's effect radius, it gives a 5&times; {{stat|Luck}} boost. Each totem lasts 30 minutes, but multiple totems can be stacked to extend the time.

== Obtainment ==
* Purchase from the [[Valentines Event Shop]] for {{Heart Crystals|200}}
* Purchase from the [[Easter Event Shop]] for 5 {{Eggs}}
* [[Dredge Master]] random reward
* [[Traveling Merchant]]
* [[Seashell_Isle#Relic_Vendor|Relic Vendor]] on [[Seashell Isle]]
* [[Prospector's_Shop#Forever_Pack|Forever Pack (Robux)]]
* [[Relic Crafting]]

== Usage ==
* Stand where you want to place the totem, select it from your backpack (or hotbar), and click '''once'''.
* To extend the time, stand in the effect radius of an already-placed totem (yours or someone else's), select the totem from your backpack/hotbar, and click once for each half-hour you want to add to the time.
* Totems cannot be moved once placed, so be careful when selecting one in your inventory, especially on mobile.

== Miscellaneous Relics ==

<tabber>
|-|Warp Device =
[[File:warpdevice.webp|thumb|A '''Warp Device''']]
A device that allows you to resonate with waypoints around the world.

The {{Warp Device}} is a device that allows you to teleport to different waypoints from any point on the map.

== Obtainment ==
* [[Excavations#tabber-Lost_City_2|Lost City excavation]] (site D) in {{Deeproot Spring}}
* [[Excavations#tabber-Mysterious_Meteors|Mysterious Meteors excavation]] (site E) in {{Fungal Marsh}}
* [[Excavations#tabber-Alien_Wreckage_2|Alien Wreckage excavation]] (site F) in {{Starfall River}}
* [[Treasure Chest|Treasure Chests]]:
** {{Volcanic Sands}}
** {{Windswept Beach}}
** {{Frostbite River}}
** {{Rotwood Swamp}}
** {{Starfall River}}
* {{Haunted_Creek#The_Cauldron|The Cauldron}} (Halloween event)
* [[Traveling_Merchant#Items_Sold|Traveling Merchant]]

== Usage ==
* Using the Warp Device prompts a confirmation: ''Are you sure you want to use Warp Device? Use again to activate.''  
* Prevents accidental consumption.  
* Choose a [[Waypoints|waypoint]] from the list to teleport there.

|-|Enchanted Scissors =
[[File:Enchanted Scissors.png|thumb|The '''Enchanted Scissors''']]
A pair of enchanted scissors. Can cut through tough vines.

The {{Enchanted Scissors}} can be acquired from completing the [[Quests#tabber-Overgrown_Grotto|Cutting Through]] quest given by the [[Old Druid]] in {{Overgrown Grotto}}. It can be used to cut the vines blocking the entrance to {{Deeproot Spring}} and those blocking the path to the Lifetouched tools.

== Obtainment ==
* Completing the '''Cutting Through''' quest.   

== Usage ==
* Walk to a vine and press the interact button to cut it. If done successfully, a message saying ''"You cut through the vines."'' will pop up.
* If you interact with the vine without the enchanted scissors equipped, a message saying ''"My shovel can't cut through these vines. I need something else."'' will pop up.

|-|Perfect Reforge Token =
[[File:Perfect Reforge Token.png|thumb|The '''Perfect Reforge Token''']]

A token that can be exchanged with the blacksmith to perfectly reforge a piece of equipment.

The {{Perfect Reforge Token}} is a consumable item that can be used to give a perfect (100%) reforge to any piece of [[Equipment|equipment]].

== Obtainment ==
* (No longer available from the [[Traveling Merchant]].)
* [[Excavations#tabber-Lost_City_2|Lost City excavation]] (site D) in {{Deeproot Spring}}.
* [[Excavations#tabber-Mysterious_Meteors|Mysterious Meteors excavation]] (site E) in {{Fungal Marsh}}.
* [[Excavations#tabber-Alien_Wreckage_2|Alien Wreckage excavation]] (site F) in {{Starfall River}}.
* [[Prospector's_Shop#Forever_Pack|Forever Pack (Robux)]]
* [[Dredge Master]] milestone reward

== Usage ==
To use the token, approach the '''[[Blacksmith]]''' [[NPCs|NPC]] while holding the desired equipment to reforge. In the first set of options, choose option 1, "Can you reforge this?" After the blacksmith tells you how much it will cost to reforge, choose option 3, "Use a perfect reforge token".

|-| Diamond Catalyst =
[[File:Prismatic.png|thumb|A '''Diamond Catalyst''']]
[[File:Diamond_catalyst.png|200px|thumb|A '''Diamond Catalyst''' in the Backpack]]

A relic that guarantees the '''Diamond''' mutation on equipment. 

The {{Diamond Catalyst}} is a legendary material that can be used to guarantee '''Diamond''' [[Mutations]] on any equipment. 

== Obtainment ==
* Day 9 [[Daily Login Bonus|daily login reward]]
* [[Excavations#tabber-Alien_Wreckage_2|Alien Wreckage excavation]] (site F) in {{Starfall River}}.
* [[Dredge Master]] milestone reward

== Usage ==
* Hold the equipment you wish to mutate.
* Interact with the [[Mutations|Mutation Forge]] at {{Frozen Peak}}.
* Select a single Diamond Catalyst in the list of ores on the left. ''Do not select any ores.''
* Click the Reroll Mutation button, then the Apply button, then click Yes when it warns about removing the previous mutation.

|-| Festive Catalyst =
[[File:FestiveCatalyst.png|thumb|A '''Festive Catalyst''']]
A relic that guarantees the '''Festive''' mutation on equipment. 

The {{Festive Catalyst}} is a legendary material that can be used to guarantee '''Festive''' [[Mutations]] on any equipment. 

== Obtainment ==
* Purchase from Shopkeeper at [[North Pole]].
* Present from Santa.

== Usage ==
* Hold the equipment you wish to mutate.
* Interact with the [[Mutations|Mutation Forge]] at {{Frozen Peak}}.
* Select a single Festive Catalyst in the list of ores on the left. ''Do not select any ores.''
* Click the Reroll Mutation button, then the Apply button, then click Yes when it warns about removing the previous mutation.

|-| Prismatic Catalyst =
[[File:Prismatic.png|thumb|A '''Prismatic Catalyst''']]
A relic that guarantees the '''Prismatic''' mutation on equipment. 

The {{Prismatic Catalyst}}is a legendary material that can be used to guarantee '''Prismatic''' [[Mutations]] on any equipment. 

== Obtainment ==
* From Presents during limited event in [[North Pole]]
* From Advent Calendar during limited event in [[North Pole]] as long as the entire Advent Calendar is completed. 
* [[Dredge Master]] milestone reward
* [[Relic Crafting]]

== Usage ==
* Hold the equipment you wish to mutate.
* Interact with the [[Mutations|Mutation Forge]] at {{Frozen Peak}}.
* Select a single Prismatic Catalyst in the list of ores on the left. ''Do not select any ores.''
* Click the Reroll Mutation button, then the Apply button, then click Yes when it warns about removing the previous mutation.
